sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 explicitly releases GPT-Realtime-2.1 and the separate distilled mini model. May 7 launches its predecessor GPT-Realtime-2. No count or neural topology is supplied.

sources.title: New Realtime models on the API
sources.evidence: July 6 announcement corroborates the exact release, speech-to-speech reasoning, function use and improved alphanumeric recognition, noise/silence and interruptions. Its caching latency improvement is an infrastructure result, not a parameter or topology disclosure. User replies are not used as specification evidence.

sources.title: Getting started with the Realtime API
sources.evidence: Uses exact gpt-realtime-2.1 in its session example; describes direct audio processing, conversation state and tools. Separately routes full-duplex conversations with a delegated backend to GPT-Live, so Live architecture is not transferred.

sources.title: Realtime conversations
sources.evidence: Exact 2.1 session examples, text/audio responses and developer-executed functions. Image-input subsection still names older versions, so exact 2.1 image support is taken from its model reference. Session lifecycle and VAD settings describe API behavior, not neural topology.

sources.title: All OpenAI models

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 provide limited API/service access and retain service intellectual property. Supports Proprietary as a descriptive distribution classification, not a named open-weight license.

sources.title: GPT-Live System Card — July 8, 2026, updated August 4
sources.evidence: Full PDF inspected, including training and comparison Tables 1–4. Comparisons name AVM and GPT-Live variants; no exact GPT-Realtime-2.1 column or count appears. Delegated full-duplex Live behavior is not evidence of Realtime 2.1 internals.

sources.title: GPT-Live-1.1 System Card — October 15, 2026
sources.evidence: Full later PDF inspected, including training, Tables 1–2 and alignment figures. It compares Live-1/Live-1.1/mini/Quip and describes their two-model system with a GPT-5.6 Terra backend for evaluations; no exact Realtime-2.1 parameter or architecture disclosure appears.

name.note: Exact official display name and undated identifier; no dated snapshot is listed.

family.note: Use the documented GPT-Realtime product series instead of the generic gpt label. This is a catalog grouping, not an inference of shared weights with GPT-Realtime-2 or GPT-4o.

release_date.note: Exact first public API release in the changelog; not the predecessor May 7 launch or the separate GPT-Live July 8 release.

open_weights.note: Released as hosted Realtime API access; no weight distribution is offered in the official model inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted service distribution under retained IP, not an SPDX model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total disclosed in the checked exact-model reference/announcement. Later first-party voice cards and comparison tables contain no exact Realtime-2.1 entry. Targeted primary-source searches for parameter counts, training and engineering found no exact-model disclosure; a direct standalone-card lookup failed. Do not substitute predecessor, mini or Live counts.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count or expert-routing specification is disclosed in the accessed exact-model sources or found in the checked later voice cards. Performance and caching latency are not parameter counts.

architecture.note: Exact model topology remains unverified after primary training/engineering/interpretability searches and later voice-card checks. Direct speech processing is established, but Transformer, dense/MoE and encoder/decoder dimensions are not. GPT-Live full-duplex/delegation and generic cache explanations do not establish this model’s structure; GPT naming alone is insufficient.

context_window.note: Exact documented total token window. The 32000 output limit is separate; do not replace 128000 with binary 131072.

modalities.note: Native text/audio/image inputs and text/audio outputs are explicitly documented. No video or independent PDF modality is asserted. Audio responses may include transcript text; the API selects an audio or text response mode.

reasoning.note: The exact model supports reasoning tokens and configurable effort. No exact default or effort enumeration is inferred from the older Realtime-2 prompting guide or forum-user configuration.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported through Realtime sessions; the host executes function calls. Responses and Chat Completions are not supported endpoints for this exact model.

patch.notes: Released July 6, 2026 as gpt-realtime-2.1; the only documented snapshot is the undated identifier. Realtime API only, with 128000-token context and 32000 maximum output. Text/audio/image input, text/audio output, configurable reasoning and function calling are documented. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked sources; neural architecture remains unverified. GPT-Live and its delegated backend are separate models.

summary: Confirm the July 6 release and exact API capabilities; use the GPT-Realtime family and Proprietary classification and replace vague description copy. Counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified after original exact-model documentation, targeted primary research searches and later voice-card comparison checks. No GPT-Live or predecessor specifications were transferred.
